hero.title: Accessibility statement
hero.lead: The Ministry of Justice is committed to making its portal accessible to everyone.

declaration.title: Commitment statement
declaration.lead: The ministry is committed to making the portal accessible, in accordance with the law on the accessibility of digital services.

paragraphs.p1: This accessibility statement applies to the justice.gouv.aor portal.
paragraphs.p2: The ministry implements the necessary actions to reach compliance with the digital services accessibility framework.

conformite.title: Compliance status
conformite.lead: The portal is partially compliant with the applicable framework.

bullets.b1: The contrast of some illustrations remains insufficient.
bullets.b2: Some videos do not yet have subtitles.
bullets.b3: Some PDF documents still need to be made accessible.

bullets.b1: Some data tables need a simplified rendering.
bullets.b2: Some forms have fields without an explicit label.
bullets.b3: Interactive maps do not have a text alternative.

etablissement.title: Drafting of this statement
etablissement.lead: Information about how this statement was produced.

tests.label: Tests
tests.value: Tests carried out in 2026 on a sample of pages

retour.title: Feedback and contact
retour.lead: If you experience an accessibility issue, you can write to us.

paragraphs.p1: Our team will respond to any difficulty within a reasonable time.

voiesRecours.title: Recourse
voiesRecours.lead: If the response you receive is not satisfactory, you can contact the competent mediator.

bullets.b1: Write to the service in charge of the portal's accessibility.
bullets.b2: Contact the mediator of public services.
bullets.b3: Bring the matter before the competent court.
